description: Complete the rule engine (F-1) and fix visibility derivation (F-3). RuleEngineService::applyAction() ignores disable_option, set_price, set_part_number, add_component/remove_component, and set_value is written but never applied to selections; ConfiguratorService never consults effects['visible_attributes'] from show actions. Implement each action end-to-end so no action type is silently ignored, and make show reveal default-hidden attributes. Depends on FEAT-001 (single BOM path, ConditionEvaluator) and FEAT-002 (set_price computed in integer cents via app/Support/Money.php).
steps: In RuleEngineService::applyAction() add handlers and initialize the matching effects keys: disable_option -> effects['disabled_options'][attributeId][optionId] = reason (reason from action->value or a default). For target_type 'option', resolve the option's attribute_id (load App\Models\AttributeOption::find(target_id) once, or batch) so the entry is keyed [attribute_id => [option_id => reason]] exactly as ConfiguratorService::evaluate() reads it. set_value stays effects['set_values'][target_id]=value. set_price -> effects['set_price']=value. set_part_number -> effects['set_part_number']=value. add_component -> effects['added_components'][] = ['component_id'=>(int)target_id,'quantity'=>1]. remove_component -> effects['removed_components'][] = (int)target_id. Keep show/hide/require/optional/warn/error.

In ConfiguratorService::evaluate() CONSUME effects before building the readonly ConfigurationResult: (a) apply effects['set_values'] onto $selections early (before pricing/BOM/partnumber/validation) so forced values propagate — rule-set values override user input; (b) after BOM generation, append added_components as synthetic rows in the rich BOM shape (load the Component to fill part_number/description/type/manufacturer/unit_price via Money cents/currency/is_mandatory=false) and drop removed_components by component_id; (c) if effects['set_part_number'] is set, use it for configurationCode instead of PartNumberService::generate(); (d) if effects['set_price'] is set, override pricing total (compute in cents via Money, keep the pricing array shape).

Fix visibility in ConfiguratorService::evaluate(): compute default-visible attribute ids (respect the product_attributes.is_visible pivot as the default-visibility source), subtract hidden_attributes, then union effects['visible_attributes'] from show actions: visibleIds = array_values(array_unique(array_merge(array_diff($defaultVisibleIds, $hiddenIds), $ruleEffects['visible_attributes']))). show must win over hide for the same attribute. If existing passing behavior assumed all-attributes-visible-by-default, preserve it (show still reveals, hide still hides); confirm against the configurator Blade before narrowing the default set.

Add tests/Feature/RuleEngineActionsTest.php (Pest), one case per action asserting the ConfigurationResult changes: disable_option -> option present in disabledOptions keyed by its attribute; set_value -> options/techSpecs reflect forced value; add_component -> extra BOM row present (and remove_component drops one); set_price -> pricing['total'] overridden; set_part_number -> configurationCode overridden. Add tests/Feature/VisibilityDerivationTest.php: an attribute hidden by default (pivot is_visible=false or a hide rule) becomes visible when a show rule's conditions are met. Run Pint and targeted tests, then the full suite.
acceptance_criteria: Each action type (disable_option, set_value, set_price, set_part_number, add_component, remove_component) produces an observable change in ConfigurationResult; none is silently ignored (RuleEngineActionsTest passes).
A show action reveals an attribute that is hidden by default; show overrides hide for the same attribute (VisibilityDerivationTest passes).
effects['set_values'] are applied to $selections so downstream pricing/BOM/validation see forced values.
set_price overrides are computed in integer cents (no float drift); pricing/BOM array shapes unchanged.
findings:
DONE. Full suite green: 36 passed (28 prior + RuleEngineActionsTest 6 + VisibilityDerivationTest 2). No action type is silently ignored.

=== RuleEngineService::evaluate() effects array (FINAL KEYS) ===
visible_attributes (list of target_id from 'show'), hidden_attributes (list from 'hide'), required_attributes (list from 'require'), optional_attributes (list from 'optional'), disabled_options ([attribute_id => [option_id => reason]]), set_values ([attribute_id => forced value]), set_price (string|int|float|null; override total in major units), set_part_number (string|null), added_components (list of ['component_id'=>int,'quantity'=>int], quantity defaults to 1), removed_components (list<int>), warnings, errors, trace. applyAction() now dispatches every action_type via match; disable_option resolves target_type 'option' -> AttributeOption::find(target_id) to key the entry by the owning attribute_id (reason from action->value or 'Disabled by configuration rule.'). set_price/set_part_number read action->value. add_component/remove_component cast target_id to int.

=== ConfiguratorService::evaluate() consumption (all effects applied BEFORE building the readonly DTO) ===
(2a) After rule evaluation, set_values are written onto $selections FIRST (rule-set overrides user input) so pricing/BOM/part-number/validation/techSpecs all see forced values. (3) disabled_options merged with compatibility using the UNION operator ($options + existing) NOT array_merge, so numeric option-id keys are preserved and rule reasons win on collision (array_merge was renumbering integer keys - fixed). (4) Visibility: defaultVisibleIds = productAttributes->where('is_visible', true) (pivot is_visible defaults true in migration, so prior all-visible behavior preserved), then visibleIds = array_unique(array_merge(array_diff(defaultVisible, hidden), effects['visible_attributes'])) so SHOW wins over HIDE for the same attribute. (5) BOM: applyComponentEffects() drops removed_components by (int)component_id, then appends added_components as synthetic rich-shape rows (Component::with('category')->find; unit_price/cost/total_price via Money cents; is_mandatory=false; item_no continues the sequence). (6) set_price overrides pricing['total'] via Money::fromCents(Money::toCents(value)) - integer cents, pricing array shape unchanged. (7) set_part_number (when non-null/non-empty) replaces PartNumberService::generate() for configurationCode.

Note: add/remove component effects live only in ConfiguratorService::evaluate(); the raw WorkspaceController generate-bom path calls BomGeneratorService::generate() directly and is unaffected. BomParityTest stays green because its scenario has only a BomRule (no config-rule component actions).

=== Tests ===
tests/Feature/RuleEngineActionsTest.php: one case per action (disable_option keyed by attribute; set_value forces selection -> techSpecs 'Option B'; add_component adds a BOM row is_mandatory=false unit_price '50.00'; remove_component drops a BomRule-produced row; set_price -> total '999.95'; set_part_number -> configurationCode 'CUSTOM-PN-001'). Uses makeConfiguredProduct() + makeRuleWithAction() helpers; rules have no conditions (empty => passes). tests/Feature/VisibilityDerivationTest.php: pivot-hidden attribute revealed only when a show rule's Equals condition matches the selection; show overrides hide for the same attribute.
